bugs_summary.description: Every turn, the agent replays update_booking from an empty/early state (services=['corte'], audience=null) before catching up to the current booking context. This results in 2-4 extra update_booking calls per turn. It does not affect correctness but wastes tokens and suggests the checkpoint state is not being fully pre-loaded before the LLM loop begins.

The 10:00 Harolyn slot offered in Turn 6 was already taken by Turn 10 (concurrent test environment). The bot's fallback was correct — it offered real alternatives rather than crashing or silently failing.

notes: Turn count reached 11 (exceeding the nominal 10) due to the slot conflict recovery needing an extra selection turn. The booking was ultimately successful. The state replay bug is the only systemic finding worth tracking — it adds overhead without impacting user experience.
